name: 10640-imageprompt-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of the node; configs/env.yaml pins what this runs on.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 2048 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text zipped with synthetic_image, single turn. Per request: one fresh synthetic 1770x1180 jpeg (solid content, quality 85), exactly 18 prompt tokens, exactly 64 output tokens; request_format is plain, so the engine expands the <image> placeholder itself to 576 image positions.
purpose: A vision chat assistant captioning single high-resolution photos with short replies for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: llava-hf/llava-1.5-7b-hf
max-model-len: 4096
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16

# Pinned because not every entry point resolves the batch budget the same way: left unset, this
# can fall back to max_num_seqs 256 and a computed max_num_batched_tokens.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
